searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (last ~40 'opportunities' entries -- Palantir FDE, 2x Anthropic Fellows, NVIDIA, Forward Deployed Engineer generic listings, and mostly Google-News-RSS fallback titles -- sent within the last 5 days), applications.json (empty; life/PIPELINE.md is the real tracker), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions (IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Tuck Business Bridge). Checked the graduation-date conflict flagged in this run's instructions: life/PROFILE.md states December 2026 was SETTLED by Dom on 2026-08-04 and both hub files now agree -- no live conflict; the 'unsettled Aug-Dec 2026' framing in this run's own instructions is stale and should be corrected at the source. Before spending search/fetch budget, re-tested the WebFetch egress path directly: fetched https://www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs and https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/xai -- both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the network proxy, identical to every hunt run since ~2026-08-18 (now roughly 5 weeks straight, per this repo's own commit history). WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible candidates (C3 AI FDE New Grad 2027, Domino Data Lab FDE New Grad 2027, several Palantir FDE New Grad reqs) but hunt.md's honesty rules explicitly forbid verifying eligibility or open-application status from a search snippet or aggregator listing alone -- actual page fetch is required and is not possible in this environment right now. No candidate could be verified, so none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output for a fifth consecutive week; this is an unresolved environment/org-level network-egress-policy gap (job-board and careers domains not allowlisted for this session's proxy), not a shortage of findable roles -- see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web for how environment egress policy is configured. This needs a human to fix the policy; no amount of additional search or retry budget will change the outcome.
